videos.title: How Jeetu Patel Runs Cisco Like the World’s Largest Startup
videos.description:
Cisco is building AI infrastructure, from networking GPU clusters to securing agents, with its hyperscaler AI business reaching $9.3 billion in orders in two years. Cisco President and Chief Product Officer Jeetu Patel joins Y Combinator Managing Partner Jared Friedman to discuss bringing startup speed to 32,000 engineers, why AI should unlock new ideas rather than just cut costs, and why he expects to need more engineers, not fewer. He also explains why he doesn’t think we’re overbuilding data centers and shares career lessons on choosing learning over ego.

videos.title: I Tested Jev, the AI Model That Makes Decisions Instead of Text
videos.description:
Get started with OpenRouter here: https://openrouter.plug.dev/DQFLEpP

This AI model can't write a single sentence. It can't code, it can't chat, and it can't summarize anything for you. Compared to a frontier model like GPT 5.5, it's about 65x cheaper to run, and for a lot of what we actually use LLMs for, I think it's the better choice.

It's called Jev, from TypeSafe AI, and it's a "System One" model: built to make one fast, structured decision instead of generating text. I spent a few weeks testing it across four real tests, including 1,000+ real customer messages and 350 sneaky shell commands, and compared it against a cheap LLM (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite) and an expensive one (GPT 5.5).
